
### Software Installation Instructions

R is available for Windows, Mac, and Linux. If you are using a Chromebook, you should instead register for a [Posit Cloud](https://docs.posit.co/cloud/get_started/) account, which will give you 25 hours a month of time for free (this is more than sufficient for this workshop). 

1. Download and install the [latest R version](https://cran.r-project.org) first, and then download and install [RStudio](https://www.rstudio.com/products/rstudio/download/).

2. Open RStudio from your applications menu. In the Console (bottom left) pane, type `install.packages("tidyverse")` and hit enter.

You should be good to go! 

If you encounter any issues, please contact [Susan Vanderplas](mailto://susan.vanderplas@usu.edu) and she can help you resolve any errors or set you up with an alternate means to use R and RStudio through the browser.
